newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht up further, interbank rate eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht up further, interbank rate eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht strengthened further against the dollar in late quiet trade on Tuesday as dollar weakness prompted more selling of the U.S. unit, dealers said.
The baht firmed to 25.885/25.895 to the dollar near the close from 25.897/25.901 in early trade, dealers said.
"There was dollar selling since the morning. But the trade was very thin as most players already squared their positions," said one dealer at a European bank.
The Bank of Thailand set the mid-rate at 25.91 per dollar against 25.94 on Monday.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 12.25-12.50 percent in late trade from 13.00 on rising liquidity, dealers said.
Dealers said dollar selling and slower demand for funds used for speculating on the dollar helped increase money supply in the system on Tuesday.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium rose to 12.00/13.00 satangs per dollar late from 11.00/12.00 early.
